_comment: Public events list. `kind`: 'festival' | 'class' | 'tasting' | 'external'. `registration`: 'none' (info only), 'external' (ticketUrl on another site), 'internal' (reserved for the on-site registration system, Phase 6; not active yet). Dates are Pacific time. Past events stay listed and are shown greyed out. An event with a `feature` block takes over the homepage hero (and gets a full page at its href) from now through the end of its last day.

events.title: Lavender Festival
events.summary: Artisan vendors, food trucks, kite flying and live music in the lavender fields. Our biggest weekend of the year.

events.title: Apple Press
events.summary: Our 5th annual Apple Press. Bring apples to press for yourself or donate them to next year’s cider. Music by Bread & Gravy, hot dogs from Underdogs, and lawn games.

feature.tagline: Bring your apples. We’ll bring the press.

highlights.title: Press your own
highlights.text: Bring apples from your trees and run them through the press for your own juice.

highlights.title: Or donate them
highlights.text: Leave your apples with us and they go into next year’s cider.

highlights.title: Music by Bread & Gravy
highlights.text: Live music from Bread & Gravy through the afternoon.

highlights.title: Hot dogs and lawn games
highlights.text: Hot dogs from Underdogs, lawn games, and the tasting room pouring all day.

feature.flyerAlt: Olympic Bluffs Cidery 5th Annual Apple Press flyer: 1025 Finn Hall Rd, Sunday October 4th, 12–5 PM. Bring apples for personal pressing or donate to next year’s cider. Music by Bread & Gravy, food, lawn games.

vendors.name: Underdogs
vendors.text: Underdogs is bringing the hot dogs to the press this year. Grab one between pressings and pair it with a pour from the tasting room.

feature.headline: An afternoon of pressing, music and fall on the farm
feature.bring: Apples, if you have them: to press for yourself or to donate to next year’s cider.
feature.wrapUp: That’s a wrap for this year. Thank you to everyone who brought apples, and see you next fall.

events.title: Yoga + Cider
events.summary: A morning flow in the lavender with Rebelution Yoga + Wellness, followed by a glass of cider. Tickets through the studio.

events.title: Yoga + Cider
events.summary: A morning flow in the lavender with Rebelution Yoga + Wellness, followed by a glass of cider. Tickets through the studio.

events.title: Howl-o-ween at the Bluffs!
events.summary: Our last day of the season, on Halloween. Bring your pets in costume for pet pictures, grab a hot dog and raise a glass of cider with us before we close for the winter. We’re closed Friday and Sunday this weekend.

feature.tagline: Our last day of the season. Bring your pets in costume.
feature.headline: One more Saturday on the farm before winter

highlights.title: Pet pictures
highlights.text: It’s Halloween, so dress up your dog (leashed, please) and get their picture taken on the farm.

highlights.title: Hot dogs
highlights.text: Hot dogs for the humans while the pups show off their costumes.

highlights.title: Cider
highlights.text: The tasting room is pouring from noon to 5. Stock up on bottles for the winter.

highlights.title: Last day of 2026
highlights.text: We’re closed Friday and Sunday this weekend. Saturday is your last chance until we reopen in the spring.

feature.flyerAlt: Howl-o-ween at the Bluffs! flyer: three dogs in witch, pumpkin and pirate costumes among jack-o’-lanterns. Olympic Bluffs Cidery, Saturday, October 31, 12 PM – 5 PM. Pet pictures, hot dogs, cider. 1025 Finn Hall Rd, Port Angeles, WA.
feature.bring: Your pets in their Halloween best, on a leash.
feature.wrapUp: That’s a wrap on 2026. Thank you for a wonderful season, and see you in the spring.
